questions.question: What is the value of 1980 ÷ 9 + [-77 + {-1980 + ((1)/(4) of 7920)}] ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1980 ÷ 9 + [-77 + {-1980 + ((1)/(4) of 7920)}]

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

Calculation:

questions.question: Vinod had ₹10,000 with him. He lent a part of it at 8% per annum simple interest and the remaining at 10% per annum. His total annual income was ₹880. Find the sum lent at 8%.
questions.solution:
Given:

Principal (P) = 10,000,

Rate of interest(R) = 8% & 10%,

Time (T) = 1 year

Annual Income = Rs 880

Formula used:

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100 

Calculation:

SI on the sum of 10,000 at the rate of 8% per annum = 10000 × 8/100

=Rs 800

Total annual Income = Rs 880

Extra interest in 1 year = 880 - 800 = Rs 80

(10 - 8) = 2% corresponds to Rs 80 

100% corresponds to Rs 4000

Money invested on 2nd part = 4000

Money invested on 1st part = 10000 - 4000 = 6000

∴ The sum lent on 8% is 6000.

questions.question: Namitha gives a 20% discount on all things in her shop and yet makes a profit of 12%. What is the cost price of an item with marked price of ₹280?

⇒ 280/CP = 7/5

questions.question: If x is the fourth proportional of 48, 72 and 108, what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Given:

1st Proportional(a) = 48

2nd Proportional(b) = 72

3rd Proportional(c) = 108

Formula Used:

4th Proportional(d) = (b x c)/a

Calculations:

According to the formula,

⇒ 4th Proportional(d) = (b x c)/a = (72 x 108)/48 = 162

⇒ Hence, The fourth proportion is 162.

questions.question: In an election between Ram and Shyamal, one got 30% of the polled votes and thus lost by 900 votes. If 90% of the voters voted and no invalid or illegal votes were cast, then what was the number of voters on the voting list?
questions.solution:
Given:

There are two candidates Ram and Shyam who appeared in an election. The candidate got 30% of the total votes and lost by 900 votes.

Formula: 

If A got a% votes and B got b% votes, difference in the votes = (a - b) % of Total votes polled

Calculation: 

Let the total votes voted be 100x

The candidate got 30% of the total votes = 30x

Winning candidate got = 100x – 30x = 70x votes

As per the question,

⇒ 30x + 900 = 70x

⇒ x = 22.50

Hence the total number of votes is 100x = 100 × 22.5= 2250.

Note that there are 90% of the total voting list.

Let the total number of the voting list be Y.

So according to the question

⇒ Y × 90% = 2250 

⇒ Y = 2500

∴ The correct answer is 2500.

questions.question: Which one of the following numbers is divisible by 24?
questions.solution:
Concept used:

A number is divisible by 24 if it is divisible by both 3 and 8.

Formula used:

Divisibility rule of 3:

A number is divisible by 3 if the sum of the digits of the number is divisible by 3.

Divisibility rule of 8:

The last 3 digits must be divided by 8.

Calculation:

In 569896, 

Sum of digits = 5 + 6 + 9 + 8 + 9 + 6

⇒ 43

Here, the sum is not divisible by 3, the number 569896 is not divisible by 24. 

In 478656, 

Sum of digits = 4 + 7 + 8 + 6 + 5 + 6

⇒ 36

Here, the sum is divisible by 3, the number 478656 may be divisible by 24.

Now check for the last 3 digits of 478656 is divisible by 8.

Note that 656/8 = 82.

So, the number 478656 is divisible by 24.

∴ The number 478656 is divisible by 24.

questions.question: While traveling from Nashik to Daman, Harsh drove for 1 hour at a speed of 50 km/h and for the next three hours at 60 km/h. What was his average speed for the whole trip?
questions.solution:
Given:

Harsh travels from Nashik to Damant for 1 hr with a speed of 50 km/h,

Again 3 hr with a speed of 60 km/h

Concept used:

Average speed = (Total distance)/(Total time)

Calculation:

⇒ Average speed = (1 × 50 + 3 × 60)/( 1 + 3)

⇒ Average speed = (50 + 180)/4 = 57.5 km/h

∴ The average speed of Harsh is 57.5 km/h.

questions.question: Raghuvir purchased some perishable items for sale but 36% of those items could not be sold and went bad. However, Raghuvir managed to sell the rest of the items at a price that helped him earn an overall profit of 28%. At what percentage above the cost price of each item did Raghuvir sell each of the items that did not go bad?
questions.solution:
Given:

36% of items went bad and total profit must be 28 %.

Concept used:

Profit = SP - CP

Profit% = (SP - CP)/CP× 100

S.P. = ( C.P. × 100) × (100 + Profit %),

where S.P. → Selling Price , C.P. → Cost Price

Calculation:

Let the cost of one item is 1 Rs.

Therefore, cost of 100 items will be 100 Rs.

As 36% went bad, so remaining items are 100 - 36 = 64.

Note that total over all profit must be 28 %.

⇒ S.P. = ( C.P. × 100) × (100 + Profit %),

⇒ S.P. = ( 100 × 100) × (100 + 28 %),

⇒ 128 Rs.

Now 64 must items must be sold in 128

Profit = SP - CP

⇒ 128 - 64

⇒ 64

Profit% = (SP - CP)/CP× 100

⇒ 64/64 × 100

⇒ 100%

∴ The correct option is 1.

⇒ Total volume = 216 + 512 + 1000 = 1728 cm3

The volume of new cube = 1728 cm3

⇒ 1728 = (SIde)3

⇒ Side = 3sqrt{12 times 12 times 12}

∴ The edge of the new cube is 12 cm.

questions.question: The factors of a² - 1 - 2x - x² are _______.
questions.solution:
Formula Used:

(a2 - b2) = (a + b)(a - b)

Calculation:

a2 - 1 - 2x - x2 

⇒ a2 - (1 + 2x + x2)

By using (a2 - b2) = (a + b)(a - b),

⇒ a2 - (1 + 2x + x2) = (a + 1 + x) (a - 1 - x)

∴ **The correct option is 2 i.e. (a + 1 + x) (a - 1 - x).**
